<body>

<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Flag Football Challenge @ Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd
Sent: 21 October 2024 10:38 PM
To: Flag Football Invite
cc: 
Subject: Kestrel/BAE Flag Football Invitation

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Redline Aviation are proud to sponsor the 2nd Annual Falcon-Phoenix Flag Football Challenge on Saturday, 16 November.  The purpose of this event is to raise money for the Bristol Aerospace Museum, and to enjoy the competitive spirit of the local rivalry.  This year's game marks the 5th meeting between Kestrel's Falcons and BAE's Phoenix, and, with a little luck, the Western League Title will be on the line!

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Redline Aviation are sponsoring the event, but we need your help as participants and fundraisers.  Contributions raised will benefit the Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Scholarship Fund.

The details:
Date:    Saturday, 16 November
Time:    10:00 a.m. - approximately 4 p.m. (Warm up is at 9:30 am)
Location:   The Aerodrome (just off Gloucester Rd, south of M32)
Food and Drinks:  The Flying Machine BBQ (FREE - courtesy of Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd)
Eligibility:   Full-time employees and/or their spouses (Players must have completed an apprenticeship at Kestrel or BAE)
Team Jerseys:  Provided by Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Redline Aviation
Format:   7 players with at least 1 female player on the field at all times
Team Size: Recommend 8-10 players per team (no more than 10 per team) Contact the team captains to sign-up.  (Sign-up now to ensure your place on a team)
Prizes:    Winning team receives 16 tickets to the Bristol Aerospace Exhibition on Friday, 22 November Winning team also owns the Kestrel Cup trophy until next year!
Fundraising Goal  The committee has set a goal of raising £8,000 for the Bristol Aerospace Museum.  This will require a contribution of £1,000 per team, plus an equal amount from corporate matching funds.

Last year's event featured a last-minute comeback as the BAE Phoenix defeated the Kestrel Falcons Team 1 for the championship and took home the tickets and the trophy.  This year, expect the Kestrel Falcons (and Redline Aviation) to come in with revenge on their minds!
Thanks to the gracious gift from the Kestrel Charity Fund, we were able to permanently endow scholarships dedicated to the memory of the Kestrel employees who died in last year's Filton factory accident.  We believe this event is a great tradition for both companies, and we are pleased to be able to raise important funds for the local community.
</quoted>
